1.text: Paul N Timotheus, tha servants of Jesus Christ, 2 all tha saints in Christ Jesus which r at Philippi, wit tha bishops N deacons:
Grace be 2 u, N peace, from God our Father, N from tha Lord Jesus Christ.
I thank my God upon every remembrance of u,
Always in every prayer of mine 4 u all makin request wit joy,
4 ur fellowship in tha gospel from tha first day until now;
Bein confident of dis very thing, dat he which has begun a good work in u will perform it until tha day of Jesus Christ:
Even as it is meet 4 me 2 think dis of u all, because I have u in my heart; since as both in my bonds, N in tha defence N confirmation of tha gospel, y’all all r partakers of my grace.
4 God is my record, how greatly I long after u all in tha bowels of Jesus Christ.
N dis I pray, dat ur love may abound yet more N more in knowledge N in all judgment;
Dat y’all may approve things dat r excellent; dat y’all may be sincere N without offence till tha day of Christ;
Bein filled wit tha fruits of righteousness, which r by Jesus Christ, 2 tha glory N praise of God.
But I would y’all should understand, brothers, dat tha things which happened 2 me have fallen out rather 2 tha furtherance of tha gospel;
So dat my bonds in Christ r manifest in all tha palace, N in all other places;
N many of tha brothers in tha Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, r much more bold 2 speak tha word without fear.
Some indeed preach Christ even of envy N strife; N some also of good will:
Tha one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing 2 add affliction 2 my bonds:
But tha other of love, knowin dat I am set 4 tha defence of tha gospel.
What then? even so, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; N I in it do rejoice, yeah, N will rejoice.
4 I know dat dis shall turn 2 my salvation through ur prayer, N tha supply of tha Spirit of Jesus Christ,

According 2 my earnest expectation N my hope, dat in nothing I shall be ashamed, but dat wit all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.
4 2 me 2 live is Christ, N 2 die is gain.
But if I live in tha flesh, dis is tha fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I know not.
4 I am in a strait betwixt two, havin a desire 2 depart, N 2 be wit Christ; which is far better:
Nevertheless 2 abide in tha flesh is more needful 4 u.
N havin dis confidence, I know dat I shall abide N continue wit u all 4 ur furtherance N joy of faith;
Dat ur rejoicin may be more abundant in Jesus Christ 4 me by my comin 2 u again.

Only let ur conversation be as it becomes tha gospel of Christ: dat whether I come N see u, or else be absent, I may hear of ur affairs, dat y’all stand fast in one spirit, wit one mind striving together 4 tha faith of tha gospel;
N in nothing terrified by ur adversaries: which is 2 ’em an evident token of perdition, but 2 u of salvation, N dat of God.
4 2 u it is given in tha behalf of Christ, not only 2 believe on him, but also 2 suffer 4 his sake;
Havin tha same conflict which y’all saw in me, N now hear 2 be in me.

2.text: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of tha Spirit, if any bowels N mercies,
Fulfil y’all my joy, dat y’all be likeminded, havin tha same love, bein of one accord, of one mind.
Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on tha things of others.
Let dis mind be in u, which was also in Christ Jesus:
Who, bein in tha form of God, thought it not robbery 2 be equal wit God:
But made himself of no reputation, N took upon him tha form of a servant, N was made in tha likeness of men:
N bein found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, N became obedient 2 death, even tha death of tha cross.
So God also has highly exalted him, N given him a name which is above every name:
Dat at tha name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, N things in earth, N things under tha earth;
N dat every tongue should confess dat Jesus Christ is Lord, 2 tha glory of God tha Father.
So, my beloved, as y’all have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out ur own salvation wit fear N tremblin.
4 it is God which works in u both 2 will N 2 do of his good pleasure.
Do all things without grumblin N disputings:
Dat y’all may be blameless N harmless, tha sons of God, without rebuke, in tha midst of a crooked N perverse nation, among whom y’all shine as lights in tha world;
Holding forth tha word of life; dat I may rejoice in tha day of Christ, dat I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.
Yeah, N if I be offered upon tha sacrifice N service of ur faith, I joy, N rejoice wit u all.
4 tha same cause also do y’all joy, N rejoice wit me.
But I trust in tha Lord Jesus 2 send Timotheus shortly 2 u, dat I also may be of good comfort, when I know ur state.
4 I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care 4 ur state.
4 all seek their own, not tha things which r Jesus Christ’s.
But y’all know tha proof of him, dat, as a son wit tha father, he has served wit me in tha gospel.
Him therefore I hope 2 send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go wit me.
But I trust in tha Lord dat I also myself shall come shortly.
Yet I supposed it necessary 2 send 2 u Epaphroditus, my brother, N companion in labour, N fellowsoldier, but ur messenger, N he dat ministered 2 my wants.
4 he longed after u all, N was full of heaviness, because dat y’all had heard dat he had been sick.
4 indeed he was sick nigh 2 death: but God had mercy on him; N not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
I sent him therefore tha more carefully, dat, when y’all see him again, y’all may rejoice, N dat I may be tha less sorrowful.
Receive him therefore in tha Lord wit all gladness; N hold such in reputation:
Because 4 tha work of Christ he was nigh 2 death, not regarding his life, 2 supply ur lack of service toward me.

3.text: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in tha Lord. 2 write tha same things 2 u, 2 me indeed is not grievous, but 4 u it is safe.
Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of tha concision.
4 we r tha circumcision, which worship God in tha spirit, N rejoice in Christ Jesus, N have no confidence in tha flesh.
Though I might also have confidence in tha flesh. If any other man thinks dat he has whereof he might trust in tha flesh, I more:
Circumcised tha eighth day, of tha stock of Israel, of tha tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of tha Hebrews; as touching tha law, a Pharisee;
Concerning zeal, persecutin tha church; touching tha righteousness which is in tha law, blameless.
But what things were gain 2 me, dose I counted loss 4 Christ.
Yeah doubtless, N I count all things but loss 4 tha excellency of tha knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: 4 whom I have suffered tha loss of all things, N do count ’em but dung, dat I may win Christ,
N be found in him, not havin my own righteousness, which is of tha law, but dat which is through tha faith of Christ, tha righteousness which is of God by faith:
Dat I may know him, N tha power of his resurrection, N tha fellowship of his sufferings, bein made conformable 2 his death;
If by any means I might attain 2 tha resurrection of tha dead.
Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if dat I may apprehend dat 4 which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.
Brothers, I count not myself 2 have apprehended: but dis one thing I do, forgetting dose things which r behind, N reaching forth 2 dose things which r before,
I press toward tha mark 4 tha prize of tha high callin of God in Christ Jesus.
Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be like dis minded: N if in any thing y’all be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even dis 2 u.
Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by tha same rule, let us mind tha same thing.
Brothers, be followers together of me, N mark ’em which walk so as y’all have us 4 an ensample.
(4 many walk, of whom I have told u often, N now tell u even weepin, dat dey r tha opps of tha cross of Christ:
Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, N whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)
4 our conversation is in heaven; from from where also we look 4 tha Saviour, tha Lord Jesus Christ:
Who shall change our vile body, dat it may be fashioned like 2 his glorious body, according 2 tha workin whereby he is able even 2 subdue all things 2 himself.

4.text: Therefore, my brothers dearly beloved N longed 4, my joy N crown, so stand fast in tha Lord, my dearly beloved.
I beg Euodias, N beg Syntyche, dat dey be of tha same mind in tha Lord.
N I intreat u also, true yokefellow, help dose women which laboured wit me in tha gospel, wit Clement also, N wit other my fellowlabourers, whose namez r in tha book of life.
Rejoice in tha Lord alway: N again I say, Rejoice.
Let ur moderation be known 2 all men. tha Lord is at hand.
Be careful 4 nothing; but in every thing by prayer N supplication wit thanksgiving let ur requests be made known 2 God.
N tha peace of God, which passes all understanding, shall keep ur hearts N minds through Christ Jesus.

Finally, brothers, whatever things r true, whatever things r honest, whatever things r just, whatever things r pure, whatever things r lovely, whatever things r of good report; if there be any virtue, N if there be any praise, think on dese things.
Dose things, which y’all have both learned, N received, N heard, N seen in me, do: N tha God of peace shall be wit u.
But I rejoiced in tha Lord greatly, dat now at tha last ur care of me has flourished again; in which y’all were also careful, but y’all lacked opportunity.
Not dat I speak in respect of want: 4 I have learned, in whatever state I am, wit it 2 be content.
I know both how 2 be abased, N I know how 2 abound: every where N in all things I am instructed both 2 be full N 2 be hungry, both 2 abound N 2 suffer need.
I can do all things through Christ which strengthens me.
Even so y’all have well done, dat y’all did communicate wit my affliction.
Now y’all Philippians know also, dat in tha beginning of tha gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated wit me as concerning givin N receivin, but y’all only.
4 even in Thessalonica y’all sent once N again 2 my necessity.
Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit dat may abound 2 ur account.
But I have all, N abound: I am full, havin received of Epaphroditus tha things which were sent from u, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing 2 God.
But my God shall supply all ur need according 2 his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
Now 2 God N our Father be glory 4 ever N ever. Amen.
Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. tha brothers which r wit me greet u.
All tha saints greet u, chiefly dey dat r of Caesar’s household.
Tha grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be wit u all. Amen.
